app.account.delete.policy: Permanently delete your account, library, chats and Publish connections. Unused Credits are forfeited and nothing is refunded. Payment records we must keep (see our Privacy Policy) stay without your name.
app.create.sources.image.hint: PNG, JPEG or WebP, up to 20 MB
app.create.sources.audio.hint: MP3 or WAV, up to 20 MB
app.editor.original.help: Music loops and sound effects synthesized on this device. Saved projects regenerate these presets when reopened.
app.editor.brand.limit: Use up to 12 hex colours separated by commas.
app.editor.credits.explanation: Editing does not require a paid plan. Buy non-expiring Credits only when you want to generate image, video or audio.
app.editor.credits.expiry: One-off Credit Packs. No renewal. Purchased Credits never expire.
app.editor.credits.policy: Prices are in USD and exclude tax. Stripe, Inc. is the Merchant of Record for Credit Pack purchases and shows the final total before payment. The existing Credits & billing flow requires purchase consent before opening Stripe Checkout.
app.editor.finder.empty: No stretch of 3 to 10 seconds was found in this clip.
app.editor.scenes.help: Finds where the shot changes in the selected video clip, on your device. Nothing is uploaded and it costs no credits. Check the markers, then add the cuts as one edit; Undo removes them all.
app.editor.finder.help: Suggests short stretches of the selected clip that are likely to work on their own, using shot changes, loudness and any captions. It runs on your device: nothing is uploaded and it costs no credits. These are suggestions to review, not a judgement of quality.
app.editor.filters.help: Strength blends this look with the current colours. Curves, motion, masks and effects stay in place. Apply to several clips makes one edit for Undo. Reset clears colour grading, including curves and animated grading.
app.film.masters.help: Edited from your generated take. Saving uses no credits.
app.editor.captions.formats: Timestamped VTT and enhanced LRC retain word timing. JSON accepts word/start/end in seconds. ASS retains text and cue timing; its style tags use your editor style.
app.editor.projectFiles.help: Project files contain your edits and media details. Keep the original media and font files; reopening may require relinking them.
app.editor.voiceover.help: Records from your microphone on this device and places the take at the playhead. Maximum 10 minutes.
app.publish.contactProfile.limit: Use up to 10 tags with letters, numbers, spaces, hyphens or underscores.
app.editor.lyrics.help: Paste lyrics you have permission to use, one display line per line. Match them to existing word timestamps from imported subtitles or local automatic captions. Review recognition before aligning, especially singing. This replaces the selected timed captions and adds karaoke highlighting; Undo restores them. It makes no paid request.
app.editor.lyrics.empty: Import word timing JSON, timestamped VTT or enhanced LRC, or create local automatic captions first. Evenly distributed word timing is an estimate.
app.editor.picture.help: Colour keying works with plain backgrounds. Noise reduction preserves strong edges; relighting adds a soft exposure spot. These tools run locally.
app.chat.attach.types: Only PNG, JPEG and WebP images, or an MP4, WebM or MOV video, can be attached.
